title: Better Card Shop
description: The main menu's Card Shop opens the Card Store: booster packs, every card in the game, and card passwords. Also the booster packs from Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex/packs.json: cards added to the game's packs, and new packs.

settings.title: Password price
settings.help: DP to unlock a card with its password (three copies). Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\prices.json can set a card's own password price. Sacred Cards and Nightmare Troubadour charged 1,000 per password too.

settings.title: Monster prices
settings.help: How the Card Shop prices one copy of a monster. attack = ATK x 1.8 / 5 (Blue-Eyes 1,080 DP). classic = Forbidden Memories' price curve, doubling every ~590 ATK+DEF (commons ~200 DP, Blue-Eyes ~7,540 DP). custom = Monster formula. flat = the flat price. Monsters with ? ATK are priced like spells and traps by rarity. Never below 100 DP. Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\prices.json can set a card's own price.

settings.title: Monster formula
settings.help: Used when Monster prices is custom. Names: ATK, DEF (a Link monster's is 0.8 x ATK), LEVEL, RARE (1 or 0), LINK (1 or 0). + - * / ^ and brackets; min, max, exp, log, sqrt, round, floor, ceil. Example: max(300, (ATK + DEF) / 5) + 300 * RARE

settings.title: Spell/Trap prices
settings.help: How the Card Shop prices spells and traps. rarity = what a typical monster of the same pack rarity costs (the game's packs mark every card common or rare). custom = Spell/Trap formula. flat = the flat price.

settings.title: Spell/Trap formula
settings.help: Used when Spell/Trap prices is custom. RARE is 1 for a card in a pack's rare slot, else 0 (ATK, DEF, LEVEL and LINK are 0 here).

settings.title: Flat price
settings.help: DP for one copy when a price setting is Flat price.
